ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large contiguous dark region occupies the central notch area and peduncle base. Distinct dark linear intersecting marks are located on the right lobe. Dense dark streaking and mottling occur on the distal left lobe tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible U-shaped central depression with an estimated 115-125 degree angle and a pixel-depth approximately 12% of the total lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire trailing edge boundary, ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in vertical deviation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips, paired with convex leading edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, dark, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible on the far right distal edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent intersecting 'X' shaped dark linear mark on the mid-right lobe; several parallel vertical dark linear markings (rake marks) on the distal left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Intersecting linear scars on the right lobe and parallel rake-mark abrasions on the left lobe distal surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The specific geometric 'X' pattern on the right lobe serves as a highly unique visual identifier.
